title: Best Oscillating Heater (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were made by reviewing the Good Housekeeping, CNET, and HeaterstoHeat sites, selecting models that appear in more than one source and noting their key features.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price comparison is made.

verdict.line: The Dreo Smart Space Heater is ideal for bedrooms and small living areas because it heats quickly, runs quietly, and has tip‑over protection. It is the only model in this guide that offers a smart‑home interface and a whisper‑quiet fan.
